changelog:
白い熊 店 4.8.4+013
• Fixes the error that made every app page fail with “Attempt to invoke virtual method … getClass() on a null object reference”, so apps can be opened and installed again
• A session that has gone bad now repairs itself on the next start instead of leaving the app stuck for good
• Update checks recover from the same fault instead of failing every time
• Backups no longer carry the signed-in account: Google credentials stay out of the archive, and importing one can no longer break a working login
